newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish April c/a seen at 5.8 bln Skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish April c/a seen at 5.8 bln Skr.

text.p: The Swedish current account for April is expected to rise to a surplus of 5.8 billion crowns from a March surplus of 4.4 billion, a Reuter poll of 12 analysts showed on Monday.
In April, 1996, the current account surplus amounted to 4.2 billion crowns.
The forecasts ranged from 4.3 billion crowns to 7.1 billion. The April 1997 trade surplus amounted to 12.3 billion crowns.
For the full-year 1997, the current account surplus was expected to reach 48.0 billion crowns, on average, a survey of eight analysts showed. In 1996, the surplus amounted to 41.5 billion crowns.
Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, will release April current account figures at 1000 GMT on June 18.

Analysts interviewed for the survey came from: Aragon, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Nomura, PaineWebber, Swedbank, Transferator, Unibank and Ohman.
